item.title: Police Suspected Keith Dardeen Until They Found Him Dead
item.description: When Elaine Dardeen and her two children were found murdered in their Illinois home in 1987, police initially suspected her missing husband, Keith. His body was discovered a mile away the next day. No one has been convicted of the family’s killings.

item.title: His Confession Led Police To Zoe Campos In His Backyard
item.description: Zoe Campos, 18, disappeared in Lubbock, Texas, in 2013. Five years later, Carlos Rodriquez confessed to killing her and helped investigators locate her remains in his backyard. He pleaded guilty to murder and was sentenced to life in prison in 2022.

item.title: Emma Walker’s Killer Didn’t Know His Friends Were Recording
item.description: After 16-year-old Emma Walker was killed in her Tennessee home in 2016, two friends of her ex-boyfriend Riley Gaul secretly recorded him for police. Their help led investigators to the murder weapon. Gaul was convicted of first-degree murder in 2018 and sentenced to life in prison.

item.title: Dylan Redwine’s Blood Was Found In His Father’s Home
item.description: Thirteen-year-old Dylan Redwine disappeared during a 2012 visit to his father in Colorado. Investigators found his blood in the living room, and cadaver dogs alerted on his father’s truck and clothing. Mark Redwine was convicted of murder and child abuse resulting in death in 2021 and sentenced to 48 years.

item.title: Mamta Bhatt’s Missed Shifts Led Police To Her Home
item.description: Virginia nurse Mamta Kafle Bhatt disappeared in July 2024. Coworkers requested a welfare check after she missed two shifts; investigators later found extensive bloodstains at home. Her husband, Naresh, denies killing her and is on trial for murder. Her remains have not been found.

item.title: Steven Stayner Saved A Child. His Brother Became A Killer
item.description: In 1980, Steven Stayner escaped seven years of captivity and brought five-year-old Timothy White to safety. Nearly two decades later, his older brother Cary murdered four people in the Yosemite area. Cary pleaded guilty to one murder and was convicted of the other three.

item.title: Nathan Carman Was Rescued. His Mother Never Returned
item.description: Nathan Carman was rescued eight days after a 2016 fishing trip with his mother, Linda. Prosecutors later accused him of killing her in an inheritance scheme, also alleging he killed his grandfather. He pleaded not guilty and died before trial in 2023; the charges were dismissed.
